title: Evidence Velocity Matrix & On-call Ownership Rotation for Compliance Evidence Streams
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: define a repeatable, measurable operating model that ensures evidence required for SOC2/ISO attestations (SSO/SAML config evidence, audit-log retention proofs, control test outputs) is produced, validated, and stored with predictable latency. Deliverables: 1) Evidence Velocity Matrix (EVM) mapping evidence type -> ownership -> SLAs -> collection method; 2) On-call rotation playbook for evidence triage and runbook-driven collection; 3) Automation backlog of ingestion/parsing tasks with priority and test coverage; 4) Dashboard for evidence staleness and TTL alerts.
acceptance_criteria: EVM published in Confluence with owner and SLA for at least 90% of required evidence items
On-call rota documented with primary/secondary owners and 2-week rotation cadence
Automated ingestion reduces manual touchpoints for SSO proof artifacts by >= 60% in pilot metadata sources
Evidence freshness dashboard shows <5% stale items in scoped controls for two consecutive weeks
Runbook includes escalation path, sample queries, and links to GitHub PR templates for evidence ingestion

decisions: Prioritize SSO/SAML artifact ingestion first because it has high manual effort and high audit value.
Use 2-week on-call rotations for evidence triage with primary and secondary owners to avoid single points of failure.
Store normalized evidence artifacts in the existing assurance-bucket with versioned keys for traceability rather than a new datastore.
Implement a lightweight webhook + lambda pattern for near-real-time evidence ingestion where sources support push delivery; fall back to scheduled collectors for others.
risks: Manual evidence processes may not fully migrate to automation within the quarter, leaving residual manual toil.
Dependencies on SSO provider APIs could introduce rate limits or schema drift affecting ingestion reliability.
Lack of ownership clarity across teams could cause stale evidence windows; mitigated by explicit on-call rota and SLAs.
Compliance audit timeline is fixed; missed deadlines could increase legal/sales friction for enterprise onboarding.
